03 — EVOLUTION TIMELINE

The Journey of AI

Scroll horizontally to explore the evolution of artificial intelligence from its origins to the present day.

1950

The Turing Test

Alan Turing proposes the "Imitation Game," laying the philosophical foundation for measuring machine intelligence.

1986

Backpropagation

Rumelhart, Hinton, and Williams popularize backpropagation, enabling neural networks to learn from errors.

2012

Deep Learning Revolution

AlexNet wins ImageNet competition, proving deep neural networks can outperform humans in visual recognition.

2017

Transformer Architecture

"Attention Is All You Need" introduces transformers, revolutionizing natural language processing forever.

2024

The SYNAPSE Era

Multimodal AI systems achieve human-level reasoning across text, image, code, and complex problem solving.

04 — EMERGENT BEHAVIOR

Beyond Programming

The most fascinating aspect of modern AI isn't what we explicitly taught it — it's what it discovered on its own. Emergent abilities arise from scale, revealing capabilities that surprise even the researchers who built the systems.
